```{r}
# View the distribution of Mito_pct to determine the cut-off
VlnPlot(seurat_object, features = "Mito_pct", pt.size = 0.1)

# --- Define Filtering Thresholds (Adjust based on your VlnPlot) ---
max_mt_percent <- 10  # Example: Filter cells with > 10% mitochondrial counts

# Filter the object
seurat_filtered <- subset(seurat_object, subset = 
    Mito_pct < max_mt_percent
)

print(paste("Cells remaining after Mito filtering:", ncol(seurat_filtered)))
```

```{r}
# Normalize data using the default LogNormalize method
seurat_filtered <- NormalizeData(seurat_filtered, normalization.method = "LogNormalize", scale.factor = 10000)

# Find highly variable features (HVGs)
seurat_filtered <- FindVariableFeatures(seurat_filtered, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000)

# Optional: Visualize the top variable features
top10 <- head(VariableFeatures(seurat_filtered), 10)
VariableFeaturePlot(seurat_filtered)
LabelPoints(plot = VariableFeaturePlot(seurat_filtered), points = top10, repel = TRUE)
```

```{r}
# Scale the data based on the HVGs
# We skip regressing out effects like Mito_pct here, but it's often a good idea!
seurat_filtered <- ScaleData(seurat_filtered, features = VariableFeatures(seurat_filtered))

# Run PCA
seurat_filtered <- RunPCA(seurat_filtered, features = VariableFeatures(object = seurat_filtered), npcs = 50)

# Visualize the PCs to determine the optimal number (e.g., using the Elbow Plot)
ElbowPlot(seurat_filtered, ndims = 50)
```

```{r}
# Set the number of PCs to use for clustering (e.g., 20)
num_pcs <- 20 
resolution_value <- 0.5 # A common starting resolution for clustering

# Find Neighbors (Build the KNN Graph)
seurat_filtered <- FindNeighbors(seurat_filtered, dims = 1:num_pcs)

# Find Clusters (Clustering)
seurat_filtered <- FindClusters(seurat_filtered, resolution = resolution_value)

# Run UMAP for 2D visualization
seurat_filtered <- RunUMAP(seurat_filtered, dims = 1:num_pcs)

# Plot the final UMAP colored by the new clusters
DimPlot(seurat_filtered, reduction = "umap", label = TRUE) + 
  ggtitle(paste0("UMAP, Resolution = ", resolution_value))

#saveRDS(seurat_filtered, file = "filtered_sc.rds", compress = TRUE)
```

```{r}
spatial_counts <- GetAssayData(seurat_obj, assay = "Spatial.016um", layer = "counts")
sc_counts <- GetAssayData(seurat_filtered, assay = "RNA", layer = "counts")

## 1. Extract Gene Names
spatial_genes_raw <- rownames(spatial_counts)
sc_genes_raw <- rownames(sc_counts)

## 2. Aggressive Cleaning and Harmonization
# a. Remove anything after a period (e.g., EnsEMBL version numbers like '.1', '.2')
# b. Convert all names to uppercase for case-insensitivity
spatial_genes_clean <- toupper(gsub("\\..*$", "", spatial_genes_raw))
sc_genes_clean <- toupper(gsub("\\..*$", "", sc_genes_raw))

# c. Assign the clean names back to the matrices' rownames
rownames(spatial_counts) <- spatial_genes_clean
rownames(sc_counts) <- sc_genes_clean

## 3. Determine the Valid Intersection
common_genes <- intersect(rownames(spatial_counts), rownames(sc_counts))

## 4. Check for Duplicates (Crucial Safety Check)
# If duplicates exist after cleaning (e.g., ENSG.1 and ENSG.2 both became ENSG), 
# you should handle them (e.g., aggregate/sum the counts) before proceeding.
cat("Number of duplicated gene names in spatial data after cleaning:", 
    sum(duplicated(rownames(spatial_counts))), "\n")
cat("Number of duplicated gene names in single-cell data after cleaning:", 
    sum(duplicated(rownames(sc_counts))), "\n")
# If the output above is 0, proceed to the next step (5).

## 5. Filter the Matrices (The step that previously failed)
# R will now filter the matrices and automatically put the common genes 
# in the order of the 'common_genes' vector.
spatial_counts_filtered <- spatial_counts[common_genes, ]
sc_counts_filtered <- sc_counts[common_genes, ]

cat("Gene filtering complete. Both filtered matrices now have", 
    nrow(spatial_counts_filtered), "common genes.\n")
```

```{r}
# The dMeltAndSum is the most robust way to aggregate
spatial_counts_agg <- Matrix.utils::aggregate.Matrix(
    spatial_counts, 
    group = rownames(spatial_counts), 
    fun = "sum"
)

# Optional: verify the number of rows is now correct (no duplicates)
cat("Spatial rows before aggregation:", nrow(spatial_counts), "\n")
cat("Spatial rows after aggregation:", nrow(spatial_counts_agg), "\n")
```

```{r}
sc_counts_agg <- Matrix.utils::aggregate.Matrix(
    sc_counts, 
    group = rownames(sc_counts), 
    fun = "sum"
)

# Optional: verify the number of rows is now correct (no duplicates)
cat("Single-Cell rows before aggregation:", nrow(sc_counts), "\n")
cat("Single-Cell rows after aggregation:", nrow(sc_counts_agg), "\n")
```

```{r}
# Recalculate common genes using the aggregated matrix row names
common_genes_final <- intersect(rownames(spatial_counts_agg), rownames(sc_counts_agg))

# Final filtering (this will now work without error and with correct counts)
spatial_counts_filtered <- spatial_counts_agg[common_genes_final, ]
sc_counts_filtered <- sc_counts_agg[common_genes_final, ]

cat("Final filtering complete. Both matrices now have", 
    nrow(spatial_counts_filtered), "correctly aggregated common genes.\n")
```

```{r}
# 1. Extract Single-Cell Annotations

cell_type_column <- "celltype"   #region_prediction
cell_types <- seurat_filtered@meta.data[[cell_type_column]]
cell_types <- as.factor(cell_types)

# Ensure the names of the cell types vector match the cell barcodes of the filtered matrix
names(cell_types) <- colnames(sc_counts_filtered)

# 2. Extract Spatial Coordinates
# Ensure the coordinates are extracted and ordered to match the spots in the filtered matrix
coords <- GetTissueCoordinates(seurat_obj)
coords <- coords[colnames(spatial_counts_filtered), ] # Reorder/filter to match spots
coords2 <- coords[, c("x", "y")]
```

```{r}
## 1. Specify the Cell Type Column 
sc_meta_data <- seurat_filtered@meta.data

if (!cell_type_column %in% colnames(sc_meta_data)) {
    stop(paste0("ERROR: Column '", cell_type_column, 
                "' not found in seurat_filtered@meta.data."))
}

cell_types_raw <- sc_meta_data[[cell_type_column]]

## 2. Robust Filtering Logic
unassigned_placeholders <- c("", "NA", "Unassigned", "Unknown", "None", "-")

is_valid_row <- !is.na(cell_types_raw) & 
                !(as.character(cell_types_raw) %in% unassigned_placeholders)

valid_meta_data <- sc_meta_data[is_valid_row, ]

valid_barcodes <- rownames(valid_meta_data)

if (length(valid_barcodes) == 0) {
    stop("FATAL ERROR: All cells were filtered out by the 'unassigned_placeholders' check.")
}

## 3. Final Preparation of Single-Cell Components
sc_counts_filtered_valid <- sc_counts_filtered[, intersect(colnames(sc_counts_filtered), valid_barcodes)]

final_barcodes <- colnames(sc_counts_filtered_valid)

cell_types <- factor(valid_meta_data[final_barcodes, cell_type_column])
names(cell_types) <- final_barcodes

if (length(levels(cell_types)) < 2) {
    stop(paste0("Error: Only ", length(levels(cell_types)), 
                " cell type(s) remain. RCTD requires at least two cell types."))
}

cat("Success! Reference data prepared with", length(final_barcodes), 
    "cells and", length(levels(cell_types)), "cell types.\n")

```

```{r}
## 4. Prepare colData and SummarizedExperiment
ref_colData <- data.frame(
    row.names = final_barcodes,
    cell_type = cell_types 
)

reference_experiment <- SummarizedExperiment(
    assays = list(counts = sc_counts_filtered_valid),
    colData = ref_colData
)

all_spatial_meta <- seurat_obj@meta.data

spatial_colData <- all_spatial_meta[colnames(spatial_counts_filtered), ]

cat("Spatial colData created for", nrow(spatial_colData), "spots.\n")

# 3. Create the SpatialExperiment object with the fixed numeric matrix
spatial_experiment <- SpatialExperiment(
    assays = list(counts = spatial_counts_filtered),
    colData = spatial_colData,
    spatialCoords = as.matrix(coords2) # spatialCoords must be a numeric matrix
)

cat("SpatialExperiment object created successfully after coordinate conversion!\n")
saveRDS(spatial_experiment, "../Random data/spatial_experiment.rds")
```

```{r}
# 1. Extract the spot classification vector
spot_classes <- colData(myRCTD)$spot_class
if (is.null(spot_classes)) {
    # If it's not in colData
    if (!is.null(myRCTD@colData@listData$spot_class)) {
        spot_classes <- myRCTD@colData@listData$spot_class
    } else {
        stop("Error: 'spot_class' could not be found in myRCTD@colData.")
    }
}

# 2. Define the mapping for cell count approximation
# Note: For multi, we conservatively use 3, but the true number can be higher.
cell_count_map <- c(
    "singlet" = 1,
    "doublet" = 2,
    "doublet_certain" = 2,
    "doublet_uncertain" = 2,
    "multi" = 3,
    "multi_certain" = 3,
    "multi_uncertain" = 3,
    "reject" = 0,
    "neg_pred" = 0 # Spots where no cell type was predicted
)

# 3. Apply the mapping to create the approximated n_cells vector
approx_n_cells_per_spot <- cell_count_map[as.character(spot_classes)]
# Handle any NA that might occur if a class is not in the map (shouldn't happen)
approx_n_cells_per_spot[is.na(approx_n_cells_per_spot)] <- 0

# Store this approximation back into colData for consistency (optional)
colData(myRCTD)$approx_n_cells <- approx_n_cells_per_spot
```

```{r}
# --- Recalculate the estimation using the approximated counts ---

# Calculate the total estimated cell number across the entire dataset
total_estimated_cells_approx <- sum(approx_n_cells_per_spot)

cat("\n## Estimated Total Cell Number (Approximated)\n")
cat("Estimated total number of cells in the entire dataset (based on spot_class):", round(total_estimated_cells_approx), "\n")
cat("Summary of approximated cells per spot:\n")
print(table(approx_n_cells_per_spot))
print(summary(approx_n_cells_per_spot))

# 1. Get the proportion matrix (Cell types x Spots)
proportions_matrix <- assay(myRCTD, "weights_full")

# 2. Use the approximated total number of cells per spot
n_cells_per_spot_vector <- approx_n_cells_per_spot

# 3. Calculate the cell count matrix: Cell Count = Proportion * Approx_Total_Count
cell_count_matrix_approx <- sweep(proportions_matrix, MARGIN = 2, STATS = n_cells_per_spot_vector, FUN = "*")

# Calculate the total estimated cell number for each cell type across all spots
cell_type_counts_approx <- rowSums(cell_count_matrix_approx)

# Convert to a data frame for easy viewing and sorting
cell_type_counts_df_approx <- data.frame(
    Cell_Type = names(cell_type_counts_approx),
    Estimated_Count = cell_type_counts_approx
)

# Sort by count
cell_type_counts_df_approx <- cell_type_counts_df_approx[order(cell_type_counts_df_approx$Estimated_Count, decreasing = TRUE), ]

cat("\n## Estimated Cell Number per Cell Type (Approximated)\n")
# Print the results, rounding to the nearest whole number for cell counts
cell_type_counts_df_approx$Estimated_Count <- round(cell_type_counts_df_approx$Estimated_Count)
print(cell_type_counts_df_approx)
```

# 12. Sub-clustering the Reference for High-Resolution RCTD
Objective: Generate 3 subclusters per cell type to resolve finer spatial patterns using RCTD.

```{r sc_subclustering_rctd}
if (exists("seurat_filtered")) {
    print("Starting sub-clustering of SC reference (k=3)...")
    
    ct_col <- "celltype"
    cell_types <- unique(seurat_filtered[[ct_col, drop = TRUE]])
    
    # Initialize container for new labels
    subcluster_labels_rctd <- character(ncol(seurat_filtered))
    names(subcluster_labels_rctd) <- colnames(seurat_filtered)
    
    for (ct in cell_types) {
        print(paste("Sub-clustering:", ct))
        cells_in_ct <- colnames(seurat_filtered)[seurat_filtered[[ct_col]] == ct]
        
        # We need enough cells to split into 3
        n_cells <- length(cells_in_ct)
        if (n_cells >= 10) {
            # Extract subset
            sub_srt <- subset(seurat_filtered, cells = cells_in_ct)
            
            # Re-process subset for fine-grained variance
            sub_srt <- FindVariableFeatures(sub_srt, verbose = FALSE)
            sub_srt <- ScaleData(sub_srt, verbose = FALSE)
            
            # PCA logic: npcs must be less than min(cells, features)
            # We'll use 10 PCs or n_cells - 1, whichever is smaller
            n_pcs_to_run <- min(n_cells - 1, 10)
            
            sub_srt <- RunPCA(sub_srt, 
                              features = VariableFeatures(sub_srt), 
                              npcs = n_pcs_to_run,
                              verbose = FALSE)
            
            # K-means on PCA space
            set.seed(42)
            # Use all available PCs for k-means
            km <- kmeans(sub_srt@reductions$pca@cell.embeddings, centers = 3)
            
            # Map back
            subcluster_labels_rctd[cells_in_ct] <- paste0(ct, "_", km$cluster)
        } else {
            # Not enough cells, keep original label
            subcluster_labels_rctd[cells_in_ct] <- ct
        }
    }
    
    seurat_filtered$Subcluster_RCTD <- factor(subcluster_labels_rctd)
    print("Sub-clustering complete.")
    print(table(seurat_filtered$Subcluster_RCTD))
}
```

# 13. High-Resolution RCTD Deconvolution
Objective: Re-run RCTD using the refined subcluster labels.

```{r run_rctd_subclusters}
if (exists("seurat_filtered") && exists("spatial_experiment")) {
    print("Preparing RCTD Reference with Subclusters...")
    
    # 1. ROBUST FILTERING: RCTD requires >= 25 cells per cell type
    cell_counts <- table(seurat_filtered$Subcluster_RCTD)
    valid_subclusters <- names(cell_counts)[cell_counts >= 25]
    
    print(paste("Filtering subclusters. Kept:", length(valid_subclusters), "out of", length(cell_counts)))
    if (length(valid_subclusters) < 2) {
        stop("Fatal: Fewer than 2 subclusters have >= 25 cells. RCTD cannot run.")
    }
    
    seurat_filtered_rctd <- subset(seurat_filtered, Subcluster_RCTD %in% valid_subclusters)
    # Drop unused factor levels
    seurat_filtered_rctd$Subcluster_RCTD <- factor(seurat_filtered_rctd$Subcluster_RCTD)
    
    # 2. Prepare Reference Experiment
    sc_counts_sub <- GetAssayData(seurat_filtered_rctd, assay = "RNA", layer = "counts")
    
    sub_labels <- seurat_filtered_rctd$Subcluster_RCTD
    # Names remain colnames of the subsetted object
    
    ref_colData_sub <- data.frame(
        row.names = colnames(seurat_filtered_rctd),
        cell_type = sub_labels
    )
    
    reference_experiment_sub <- SummarizedExperiment(
        assays = list(counts = sc_counts_sub),
        colData = ref_colData_sub
    )
    
    # 3. Setup RCTD
    myRCTD_sub <- spacexr::createRctd(
        spatial_experiment = spatial_experiment,
        reference_experiment = reference_experiment_sub,
        cell_type_col = "cell_type"
    )
    
    # 3. Run RCTD
    print("Running RCTD (Subclusters)...")
    myRCTD_sub <- spacexr::runRctd(myRCTD_sub)
    
    # 4. Save Results
    output_dir <- "/home/mattia/Thesis/111125ST_def/Random data"
    saveRDS(myRCTD_sub, file.path(output_dir, "myRCTD_subclusters.rds"))
    print("RCTD Subcluster Deconvolution complete.")
}
```

# 14. Visualization: RCTD Subclusters
Objective: Map subcluster proportions back to the tissue.

```{r viz_rctd_subclusters}
if (exists("myRCTD_sub")) {
    print("Visualizing Subcluster RCTD Results...")
    
    # 1. Spot Class Distribution
    plotCoords(myRCTD_sub, annotate = "spot_class", point_size = 1.2, in_tissue = NULL) +
        ggtitle("RCTD Subcluster Classifications")
    
    # 2. Batch Abundance Maps (9 per window)
    all_subclusters <- rownames(assay(myRCTD_sub, "weights"))
    
    # Exclude any generic labels if present
    plot_sub_cols <- setdiff(all_subclusters, "unk")
    
    n_cols <- length(plot_sub_cols)
    batch_size <- 9
    n_batches <- ceiling(n_cols / batch_size)
    
    plot_df_sub <- data.frame(
        colData(myRCTD_sub),
        spatialCoords(myRCTD_sub)
    )
    
    for (i in 1:n_batches) {
        start <- (i - 1) * batch_size + 1
        end <- min(i * batch_size, n_cols)
        current_batch <- plot_sub_cols[start:end]
        
        print(paste("Plotting Batch", i, ":", paste(current_batch, collapse=", ")))
        
        plots <- lapply(current_batch, function(ct) {
            # Add proportion to plot_df temporarily
            df_temp <- plot_df_sub
            df_temp$Prop <- assay(myRCTD_sub, "weights")[ct, rownames(df_temp)]
            
            ggplot(df_temp, aes(x = x, y = y, color = Prop)) +
                geom_point(size = 1.2) +
                scale_color_viridis_c(option = "magma") +
                coord_fixed() +
                theme_void() +
                ggtitle(ct)
        })
        
        # Combine and print
        for(p in plots) print(p)
    }
}
```
